limits: Matched decisions use the retained original-policy prefix with identical physics, controller history and in-flight shells.
The opponent keeps the original policy; all arms suppress later subject reactive decisions while ordinary range/footing and actual shells continue.
Every earlier checkpoint and complete control continuation is preserved; the new preference does not reset controllers or advance the firing schedule.
Horizons end at battle end or 20 seconds; damage is limited by remaining health and different survival times.
Only three eligible checkpoints activate priority. Some seed pairs generate identical courses; this is not an independent match win-rate sample.
Final ordinary-duel controller reports retain the most recent priority per tank, not a lifetime count.
Timing covers the whole evolving desktop simulation; this does not isolate AI cost or qualify Raspberry Pi timing.
